pey.translation: abbr. photoelectric yield 光电子产额

peyer's glands.definition:
Patches of lymphoid nodules, in the walls of the
   small intestiness; agminated glands; -- called also Peyer's patches. In
   typhoid fever they become the seat of ulcers which are regarded as the
   characteristic organic lesion of that disease.
peyer's glands.translation: [医] 派伊尔氏腺(淋巴集结)

peyer's patch.translation: [网络] 派伊尔淋巴集结；于派伊尔淋巴结；氏斑

peyer's patches.translation: [医] 派伊尔氏淋巴集结, 淋巴集结

peyman.translation: [人名] [南方英格兰人姓氏] 佩曼来源于Pay,含义是“佩伊之仆”(servant of Pay)

peyote.definition:
n a small spineless globe-shaped cactus; source of mescal buttons
n the hallucinatory alkaloid that is the active agent in mescal buttons

peyotes.translation: 仙人掌的一种( peyote的名词复数 )

peyronie's disease.translation: [医] 佩罗尼氏病(纤维性海绵体炎)

peyrot's thorax.translation: [医] 佩罗氏胸(斜卵圆形胸)

peytrel.definition:
n. The breastplate of a horse's armor or harness. [Spelt also
